### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Scalar transport reconstructs the ratio to conserved dry density and upwinds it with the hydro dry-mass flux.
YAML nvar default 0; upper-bound default -1 (disabled).
Order: code map; no independent measured convergence order.
No defining equation: this section maps control flow or data ownership.
:::

Scalar transport reconstructs the ratio to conserved dry density and upwinds it with the hydro dry-mass flux. It
therefore follows hydro in each stage. Names supplied in YAML set the scalar count; missing reconstruction inherits
the horizontal hydro choice.

### Derivation

No separate derivation: this section describes an interface or control-flow path. Numerical operators are derived in
their owning chapters.

### Numerical method

Horizontal panel exchange uses directional left/right keys with interpolation disabled. The donor factor also uses a
raw exchange, followed by physical boundary functions, before flux scaling. The scalar stage result is combined by the
parent MeshBlock. Implicit dry transfer and dry-source carry are described in @sec-ch01-stage. Reconstruction,
boundary and limiter choices determine accuracy; no scalar convergence rate is measured in this code map.

### Limits

The forward routine divides directly by conserved dry density. Its behavior for a zero dry-density field is not
established by the positive-density scalar tests cited here. The upper-bound and positivity mechanisms are documented
by the moist and positivity chapters; combinations remain in @sec-ch12-matrix.
